instruction: Convert the essay document "Recruitment_and_retention_of_health_professionals_across_Europe.docx" in /home/user to PDF format and save it in the same directory.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting a docx file to PDF format. Evaluator checks if the PDF file exists at the expected location and has a reasonable file size (>50KB to ensure it's not empty). This verifies the agent successfully performed the PDF export operation.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the core instruction requirement: PDF file exists at the expected location
Getter logic is correct: uses bash stat command to check file existence and extract size
Metric logic is correct: checks both existence and minimum size threshold (50KB)
Expected values are semantically correct: exists=true, min_size_kb=50 ensures non-empty PDF
Data flow is correct: getter extracts file state -> metric validates against expected rules
No postconfig needed: file operations are persistent, no UI/dialog dependencies
Practical and feasible: filesystem state is accessible via bash commands
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Evaluator doesn't verify PDF content matches source .docx content (but this may be overkill for basic conversion tasks)
Minor: Evaluator doesn't verify PDF is valid/not corrupted (though 50KB threshold provides basic sanity check)
